( mfn. ) heavy; weighed down; Ja I 196, 4´ (dhuraṃ garu ~aṃ hoti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee bhārikaṃ); V 76, 18 (mayaṃ mahante mahante pāsāṇe gilitvā ~ā hutvā); 84, 30 (nāgo … pāsāṇe ca vālukaṃ ca gilitvā bhāriko hutvā); 477, 23 (rājā alaṅkatakāle bhāriko bhavissati); VI 339, 23´ foll. (mūlaṃ °-tāya paṭhamaṃ udake nimujji … rukkhassa nāma mūlaṃ ~aṃ hoti udāhu aggan ti, Be so; Ce, Ee bhārikatāya; Se bhāritāya); Mil 261, 29 (mahānāvā garukā bhārikā); Vism 108, 5 (nivāsanapārupanaṃ … kiliṭṭhaṃ bhārikaṃ kicchapariharaṇaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee bhāritaṃ); Sp 326, 27 (~aṃ bhaṇḍaṃ nīharituṃ asakkonto, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee bhārikaṃ); 784, 23 (vihārassa bhārikattaṃ); Ap-a 280, 12 (garuṃ ~aṃ nāgaṃ gilatī ti garuḷo); Vibh-a 26, 4 (phalāni attano bhārikatāya paṭhamataraṃ paṭhaviyaṃ patanti); — 2. ( mfn. ) weighty; important; Mil 240, 5 (kiṃ nu kho bhante Nāgasena tathāgato saṅgharatanato na bhāriko na garuko na dakkhiṇeyyo); 311, 9 (asaṅkhatā nibbānadhātu garukā bhārikā vipulā mahatī); 357, 7 (atuliyaṃ dhutaguṇaṃ … garukaṃ ~aṃ mahantaṃ); Ps II 309, 16 (garū ti bhāriko, akāmā anuvattitabbo); — 3. ( mfn. ) severe, serious, grievous, terrible; ( n. ) a grievous thing; Ja III 456, 21 (musāvādo nāma ~o guṇaparidhaṃsako); IV 406, 29 (cakkhudānaṃ nāma ~aṃ, upadhārehi devā ti); V 263, 30 (pitughātakammaṃ ~an ti); VI 381, 16 (rājakammāni nāma ~āni); Vism 425, 19 (~aṃ kammaṃ ānantariyasadisaṃ … satekicchaṃ pana hoti); Spk I 142, 26 (~o ayaṃ mahārāja supino, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se bhāriko); Mp I 36, 23 (aho ~o bhante mahānirayo ti); Dhp-a III 30, 15 (adiṭṭhasaccassa pana paṭisandhi nāma ~ā ti); It-a I 68, 10 (Devadattena saṅghaṃ bhindantena ~aṃ kammaṃ katan ti); Nidd-a I 207, 6 (paṇṇattiṃ vītikkamanto bhikkhu ~aṃ karoti) ≠ Vibh-a 493, 11 ; Cp-a 122, 19 (taṃ °-taraṃ hutvā mayhaṃ upaṭṭhātī ti); Mhv 4:40 (~aṃ te kataṃ kammaṃ); — 4. ( mfn. ) difficult; hard; burdensome; ( n. ) a difficult thing; Vism 180, 11 (na-y-idaṃ mādisassa ~an ti); 635, 12 (samādhiṃ bhante vaḷañjethā ti, na-y-idaṃ āvuso ~an ti); Sp 205, 29 (pabbajjā pi ca nām’ esā ~ā); 243, 16 (paṭhamapārājikavaṇṇanā ca na ~ā bhavissati); Ps II 2, 28 (laddhapiṇḍiyālopena santussamāno ~aṃ karotī ti); 159, 26 (kiṃ pana pañhassa pucchanaṃ ~aṃ udāhu vissajjanan ti); V 33, 11 (sace te Bhaggava agarū ti sace tuyhaṃ ~aṃ aphāsukaṃ kiñci natthi); — 5. ( m. ) a porter; Abh 514 (bhāravāho tu ~o); — -bhāriyā ifc in Ee at Ja VI 563, 3* is prob. wr for -hāriyā ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — bhārikena (hadayena) in Ee Pv-a 82, 25 is prob. wr; Be, Ce, Ee manuññena; — abhāriya , abhārika, mfn. , not heavy; not burdensome, not difficult; Sv 252, 13 (agarū ti abhāriko); As 150, 31 (adandhanatā ti … ~-tā ti attho); — atibhāriya , atibhārika, atibhārita, mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) very heavy; too heavy; over-burdened; Vin IV 47, 7 (atibhārito vihāro paripati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se atibhāriko); Ja IV 485, 18 (atibhārikā hutvā ujukaṃ uppatituṃ na sakkhissāmā ti); Mil 278, 13 (sineru atibhārikatāya acalo, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se atibhāratāya); Ps II 242, 8 (ukkhipituṃ asakkuṇeyyaṃ ~aṃ); — 2. ( mfn. ) too severe; very serious, very grievous; too difficult; ( n. ) a very terrible thing; Ja III 139, 12 (tumhehi ~ā sapathā katā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee bhāriyā); VI 3, 26 (aho mama pitā rajjaṃ nissāya ~aṃ nirayagāmikammaṃ karotī ti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee bhāriyaṃ); Sp 147, 11 (idha pana vuccamāne ~aṃ vinayanidānaṃ hoti); Dhp-a I 186, 9 (~aṃ vata seṭṭhinā katan ti).
CPD: a-bhārika , mfn. [ 3 a + sa. bhārika; peṃaps better °bhariya], 'not burdensome', not difficult; m. ~o, Sv l 252, 13 (= 'agaru', 3).
